# Deterministic frozen-source rows for the complex no-TypeTree managed-schema project export route.
# Captured from the frozen AssetRipper 2.0.0 source snapshot running in an isolated copy against a
# source-authored Unity 2019.4.40f1 (generation 21) SerializedFile holding one no-TypeTree MonoBehaviour
# backed by a managed assembly, its local MonoScript, and one TextAsset target object.
# This file freezes one source capture. Its captured TextAsset GUID is retained for traceability;
# only the explicitly listed generated GUID and importer fields may be normalized in comparisons.
#
# Normalization rules applied when comparing the Rust project output against these rows:
#   1. Substituting the Rust-generated TextAsset GUID for the frozen source GUID in TARGET_GUID is the only
#      permitted content substitution, because the source mints that GUID per export.
#   2. guid: and timeCreated: lines are dropped from every .meta file for the same reason.
#   3. The exported assembly bytes must equal the committed fixture DLL byte-for-byte.
#
# Source-authored input SerializedFile as lowercase hexadecimal, no separators.
INPUT_HEX|
# The managed assembly the MonoScript resolves to. Length is pinned; the SHA-256 is intentionally not,
# because the fixture assembly records its build-time commit in its informational version.
ASSEMBLY|ComplexFixtureScripts.dll|5120
# Object inventory reported by the source export, as ClassID|PathID|Name.
OBJECT|MonoBehaviour|42|RichRoot
OBJECT|MonoScript|7|RichController
OBJECT|TextAsset|9|Target
